Army Chief of Staff · 1955–1959 · at the opening, 1955-11-01

Army Chief on the opening date, five months into the job. Would be the war’s most travelled general: Kennedy’s military representative, Chairman, ambassador in Saigon, one of the Wise Men.

The office

The Joint Staff, the Pentagon, Arlington, Virginia. The Chairman’s office is on the E-ring, second floor, river side; the Chiefs meet in the “Tank”, Room 2E924, and from 1972 in the Gold Room next to it.
